query: select pl_name,hostname,pl_letter,pl_controv_flag,sy_snum,sy_pnum,cb_flag,sy_dist,ra,dec,disc_year,discoverymethod,pl_orbper,pl_orbperlim,pl_orbper_reflink,st_spectype,st_teff,st_tefflim,st_teff_reflink,st_rad,st_radlim,st_rad_reflink,st_age,st_agelim,st_age_reflink,sy_dist_reflink,disc_refname from pscomppars where pl_controv_flag=0 and sy_snum=1 and cb_flag=0 and hostname in (select hostname from pscomppars where sy_dist<=100 and ra is not null and dec is not null) order by hostname,pl_name
